title: Pair-production transport operator
description: A Monte Carlo photon transport operator that maps activity density to the density of electron-positron pairs through the patient's CT, for PET imaging of the 2.6145 MeV emission of 208Tl in the 212Pb chain, with the CT-to-coefficient conversion that feeds it. Release pmb-r1 is the version used in the revised manuscript (L A Polson and Y Seo, Physics in Medicine & Biology, under review).
